title: A finite group of prime-power order admits a finite central series
statement:
Let $p$ be a prime, let $a\geq0$ be an integer, and let $P$ be a finite group (its underlying set is finite in the sense of [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set]) of order $p^a$. There are an integer $c\geq0$ and normal subgroups
$$1=P_0\leq P_1\leq\cdots\leq P_c=P$$
such that $[P,P_{j+1}]\subseteq P_j$ for $0\leq j<c$, where $[P,P_{j+1}]$ is the subgroup generated by $xyx^{-1}y^{-1}$ with $x\in P$ and $y\in P_{j+1}$.
